faq.heading: What is FFS Web?
faq.content: The browser version of FFS. You can plan and track money in the browser. It is a separate product from the Android app.

faq.heading: Does this sync with the Android app?
faq.content: No. Money you enter on the website does not appear on the phone, and the other way around.
